authors: M. Mosca, M. Piani (evolutionQ) for the Global Risk Institute
published_note: Cover of the PDF says March 2026; the GRI landing page shows 9 March 2026.
event: A quantum computer able to factorize a 2048-bit number in less than 24 hours (RSA-2048), PDF p.70
bound_meaning: lower = pessimistic assignment (lowest probability compatible with the bin each expert chose); upper = optimistic assignment (highest). The interval reflects the width of the answer bins, not disagreement among experts (PDF p.30).
anchor_note: Year-level only. The report gives no fielding date and aligns horizons to calendar years (PDF p.33; a 10-year horizon is roughly 2035, PDF p.54), so the anchor is the survey year. Vary it within 2025 in the sensitivity analysis.
beyond_30_years: Not used: the report assigns 100% to more than 30 years, if ever, so the curve is not defined past 30 years for this model.
